'''Focus of Hanaku''' is a foe that appears in [[Rhea's Crater]]. It is one of the few non-boss foes in [[Factions]] that drops its own [[unique item]], [[Hanaku's Focus]].

== Locations ==
* [[The Jade Sea]]
** {{NPC location|Rhea's Crater}}

== Skills ==
20 [[Domination Magic]] in [[Hard mode]]
* {{skill icon|Energy Surge}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Ether Feast}}
* {{skill icon|Hex Breaker}}
* {{skill icon|Mind Wrack}}
* {{skill icon|Spirit Shackles}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Bone]]
* [[Hanaku's Focus]] ([[unique]])
* [[Kraken Eye]]
* [[Monstrous Claw]]
* [[Monstrous Eye]]
* [[Monstrous Fang]]
* [[Regurgitated Mass]]

== Notes ==
* Does not spawn post-Winds of Change cleansing.
* Although the Focus of Hanaku drops a unique item, it is not a boss; thus its death neither gives a [[morale boost]] nor recharges skills.
* The name of this creature suggests it may be a minion or relation of the mighty Kraken [[Zhu Hanuku]].
{{Anomaly|This creature deals double damage even though it is not actually a [[boss]].}}
